acceptance_predicates.description: A task can carry exactly the validated spec_acceptance fields required for done admission.
Missing, malformed, mismatched, or unknown acceptance evidence remains rejected.
Development-only authentication, signature, and key-management warnings remain visible and nonblocking without establishing production evidence.
The contract supplies sufficient evidence metadata for supported closure of AR-1649, AR-1650, and AR-1656.

definition_of_done: Focused task-spec and handoffctl tests pass for accepted and rejected metadata.
Exact generated projections, independent review, signed+DCO commit, and hosted coordination checks pass.

inputs.description: Task metadata, referenced task spec, evidence class, evidence reference, and SHA-256 evidence digest.

outputs.description: A typed spec_acceptance record admitted only when all required fields and references are valid.

gates.description: Done admission remains fail closed and accepts only exact validated acceptance metadata.
